nodes.text:
🚨 A New Respiratory Threat? 🚨

Malaysia sees a 45% spike in #HMPV cases following China’s outbreak! 🦠

HMPV, a virus mimicking the common cold, can lead to bronchitis & pneumonia in severe cases.

Handwashing, masks, & vigilance are key to curbing the spread. 🧴😷

Stay safe!
